findings.design: TrajectoryCallout/TrajectoryInsufficient sits at the bottom of the 'Readiness over time' section, directly below the readiness chart + accuracy bars card, as a conclusion drawn from the visible trend.
findings.app: TrajectoryCallout is rendered immediately after CertTabs, before the 'This month' usage stats grid and before the readiness chart is shown at all — first thing on the page.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Progress.html:347-366 (ProgressPage: UsageStats → readiness card → TrajectoryCallout) vs apps/web/app/pages/user-certifications/[id]/progress.vue:70-95 (TrajectoryCallout at line 74, before the stats grid at line 76 and ReadinessAccuracyCard at line 90)

findings.design: Mastered domains move under a divider labeled 'Mastered', render with strikethrough name, dimmed/greyed score bar, a 'Mastered' pill badge, and an 'Unretire' button to reverse the state; state persists across sessions.
findings.app: ProgressDomainRow tracks a local ref `mastered` that toggles the button to plain text 'Mastered' in place — no divider/section move, no strikethrough, no dimmed bar, no pill badge, and no 'Unretire' affordance. State is not re-derived from fetched data (useDomainScores has no mastered/suppressed flag), so it resets on reload.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Progress.html:188-238 (DomainRow mastered branch), 376-387 (mastered section divider) vs apps/web/app/components/ProgressDomainRow.vue:19,46-55 and apps/web/app/composables/useDomainScores.ts:13-31 (no mastered flag)

findings.design: ReadinessChart shows first/middle/last session date labels along the X axis (e.g. 'Jun 2', 'Jun 21', 'Today').
findings.app: ReadinessTrend renders only Y-axis grid tick labels (25/50/75/100) and the target label; no X-axis date labels are rendered anywhere.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Progress.html:120-121,157-162 (labelIdxs / X labels) vs apps/web/app/components/ReadinessTrend.vue:39-45,118-127 (only Y tickLabels, no X labels)

findings.element: Readiness chart area fill and projection line
findings.design: Chart fills the area under the line (rgba(124,140,248,0.07)) and, when trajectory data exists, draws a dashed projection line from the last point toward the 80% target.
findings.app: ReadinessTrend draws only the grid, target line, polyline, and points — no area fill path and no projection segment, even when the trajectory/pace callout is shown.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Progress.html:109-111,137-142 (areaPath, showProjection path) vs apps/web/app/components/ReadinessTrend.vue:66-116 (svg content: grid, target line, polyline, circles only)

findings.element: 'This month' section label and per-stat cards
findings.design: UsageStats renders under an uppercase 'This month' SectionLabel, with each stat (Sessions, Questions answered, Study time, Current streak) in its own bordered surface card.
findings.app: The stats grid has no 'This month' heading at all, and all four ProgressStatCard items share a single bg-black/25 container instead of individual bordered cards.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Progress.html:312-327 (UsageStats with SectionLabel + per-card surface/border) vs apps/web/app/pages/user-certifications/[id]/progress.vue:76-88 (no heading, shared container, ProgressStatCard.vue:12 has no border/card wrapper)

findings.element: Section header counters ('N sessions', 'Last N sessions', 'N sessions total')
findings.design: Section headers for readiness, accuracy, and session history each show a live count (e.g. '10 sessions', 'Last 6 sessions', '7 sessions total') next to the section label.
findings.app: ReadinessTrend shows a static 'Readiness Trend' label, AccuracyBars shows a static 'Accuracy per Session' label, and ProgressSessionHistoryTable shows a static 'Session History' label — none display a session count.

findings.design: Each history row shows date on one line and the session's start time (e.g. '3:42 PM') as a secondary line beneath it.
findings.app: Row only renders `friendlyDate(row.startedAt)` (e.g. 'Today, Jun 23') with no time-of-day sub-line.

findings.design: Only the most recent (last) bar shows its accuracy percentage above it; earlier bars show no numeric label.
findings.app: Every bar shows its percentage number above it, just with different text color/weight for the last one.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/Progress.html:249-250 ({isLast && <span>...}) vs apps/web/app/components/AccuracyBars.vue:25-30 (label rendered for every point)

findings.design: Each accuracy bar has a short date label beneath it (e.g. 'J16', 'J17', 'Today').
findings.app: AccuracyBars renders no label beneath each bar at all.

findings.design: ProgressPage content pane is a flexible full-width region next to the sidebar (flex:1, padding 28px 36px, no max-width cap) sized to hold a 740px-wide chart and full-bleed cards/tables.
findings.app: Page content is wrapped in a centered `mx-auto max-w-[720px]` column inside the shared `<main>`, constraining width regardless of viewport.

findings.design: Section labels read 'Readiness over time' and 'Domain scores'.
findings.app: Equivalent labels read 'Readiness Trend' (inline, inside the card) and 'Domain Breakdown' (CardPanel label), with different casing/wording and no separate section-level heading outside the card for the readiness chart.
